rows.name: Vermont Board of Medical Practice
rows.mandate: Licenses and disciplines Vermont's physicians, physician assistants, and podiatrists. Seventeen members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent — nine physicians, a PA, a podiatrist, and six public members (26 V.S.A. 1351).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Vermont Statutes; VT publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Vermont Fish and Wildlife Board
rows.mandate: Sets hunting, fishing, and trapping rules for Vermont's fish and wildlife. Fourteen members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent, one from each county (10 V.S.A. 4041).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Vermont Statutes; VT publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)
